newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers lower, demand weak.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers lower, demand weak.

text.p: North American bunker prices stepped down early this week amid weak demand ahead of the Easter holiday that begins on Friday, players said Tuesday.
"There just seems to be some short-term requirments that have to get done. Other than that it is pretty quiet," said an East Coast trader.
Prices in New York Harbor were pegged $4 below last Thursday at between $94 and $95 a tonne. The 180 CST barrels were at about $101 a tonne.
Houston 380 CST barrels traded largely on par with New York although 180 CST was $97/99 a tonne.
